title: Jail up to 3 years, fine for insulting Vande Mataram: Amit Shah to introduce Bill in Parliament Monsoon Session today
description: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026, which will amend the 1971 law, is scheduled to be introduced in the Rajya Sabha by Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Monday, the first day of the Monsoon Session of Parliament
